item.title: [News] OpenAI and Poland’s NASK partner to advance AI safety and security
item.description: OpenAI has partnered with Poland’s NASK National Research Institute to jointly advance AI safety and security research, aiming to identify and mitigate emerging AI risks. The collaboration focuses on strengthening safeguards, evaluating capabilities, and sharing incident reporting frameworks for a more resilient digital ecosystem.

item.title: [News] Does Your Model Run on AWS Trainium? Look It Up
item.description: Hugging Face has released a new TorchNeuronX Space that lets users check if their PyTorch Transformer models can run unmodified on AWS Trainium, complete with scripts and performance metrics. This resource enables IT engineers to assess and potentially accelerate AI workloads on AWS’s custom inference hardware.

item.title: [News] Rapidly scaling online storage to serve over 1 billion ChatGPT users (Part II)
item.description: OpenAI has detailed how it scaled its Habitat storage platform to serve over 1 billion ChatGPT users by optimizing Azure Cosmos DB for massive multi‑tenant workloads. The post highlights the trade‑offs between single‑tenant and multi‑tenant architectures and the performance gains achieved with co‑managed containers.

item.title: [News] Bringing foundational models to the front lines of TB screening
item.description: Google AI has announced the release of MedGemma, an open foundation model for tuberculosis screening that can interpret chest radiographs with radiologist-level accuracy. The model, showcased at IDWeek 2026, aims to democratize TB detection in low-resource settings by enabling rapid, AI-assisted screening.

item.title: [News] Hottest toy for Christmas? Nvidia CEO plays with adorable Microduck robots, 20,000 sell
item.description: Nvidia’s CEO showcased Microducks, open‑source robots from Hugging Face’s Pollen Robotics, at GTC Berlin, sparking viral buzz and 20,000 pre‑orders. The robots run on Nvidia’s AI stack and can be re‑trained by users via a shared community platform.
